notes.title: So Much Stuff 3 - Now Available!
notes.content:
Play So Much Stuff 3: Odds & Ends and dive into a delightful journey of sorting through an array of beautiful themes, clearing out a multitude of items and trinkets. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44385783/9fd4e32c070c1ae05b4eb1bcbf753b503890b6a1.gif[/img]

In this new set of beautifully created hidden object scenes, you will sort through unique odds & ends! Feel the satisfaction of organizing and decluttering! Sort through fun and interesting new themes and play a whole new set of mini-games!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44385783/78d364c02bf11b73bc46544c033c6373318afd89.gif[/img]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Play over 100 games!
[*]Downloadable wallpapers
[*]Full soundtrack and music player
[*]Make gameplay simpler with Help and Hint functions!
[/list]

[h2]Collector's Edition[/h2]
[list]
[*]includes 8 extra themes
[*]18 Downloadable Wallpapers
[*]Music player
[*]1 more collection room
[/list]

Sit back, relax, and indulge in a diverse selection of engaging mini-games such as jigsaws, find the difference, and click to swaps!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2463730/So_Much_Stuff_3_Odds__Ends/

notes.title: So Much Stuff - Now Available!
notes.content:
The ultimate sorting and matching game that will put your object recognition skills to the test! With 18 exciting themes for the levels, 4 challenging game modes, and brain-teasing puzzles and find-the-difference minigames, this game is sure to provide hours of fun and challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43639825/313fef43713a278c4205eeb7dcbbe6cd1a2c0a4d.gif[/img]

Immerse yourself as you sort and organize an assortment of items for your fun and enjoyment! Go through various levels and clear out different scenes while collecting little trinkets to fill a room with!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43639825/9ee158c4d4c2ae1c95db1ea0a29c67c0b47e9892.gif[/img]

[h3]Collector's Edition[/h3]
[list]
[*] Includes 6 extra themes
[*] 18 Wallpapers
[*] Background Music
[*] 1 more collection room
[/list]

Get ready to sort and match objects, challenge yourself with tricky brain teasers, and enjoy a relaxing and enjoyable gaming experience. Download "So Much Stuff" now and start your sorting and matching journey!
